content.text:
osc(10, 0.1, 300)
  .color(0.2, 0.9, 1)
  .diff(
    osc(10, 0.1, 1)
    .color(0.9, 0.1, 1)
    .rotate(()=>time*0.4)
    .kaleid()
  )
  .scrollY(()=>-time * 0.5)
  .colorama()
  .luma()
  .color(0.7, 0.2, 2)
  .repeat(4)
  .modulate(o0, 0.1)
  .scale(2)
  .out()
content.title: hydra.ojack.xyz

    .rotate(0, 0.4)
    .mult(osc(10, 1).modulate(osc(10).rotate(0, -0.1), 1)).colorama().luma()
    .color(0.1,0.9,3)
    .scrollX(()=>time*0.1)
    .pixelate(100)
  .out()
